description: This file defines the HomeComponent for an Angular application. It manages displaying a list of recipes, applying filters, and toggling favorites. It interacts with RecipeService for fetching and searching recipes, and FavoritesService for managing favorite recipes.

classes.name: HomeComponent
classes.description: Angular component for the home page displaying recipes with filtering and favorites toggling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component; fetches all recipes and applies filters.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs recipe search based on current filters.

methods.name: onToggleFav
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe by ID.
